Active music supplied by the project owner: Galactic Slot Loop.mp3 (main game) and Bonus Music.MP3 (all bonus scenes). Original uploaded audio bytes preserved in galactic-slot.mp3 and bonus-music.mp3.

Legacy soundtrack information:
BOUNTY BREAKERS — ORIGINAL GAME SOUNDTRACK

Created for Gamboligy Games, September 2026.
Four original 140 BPM, D-minor chiptune / dubstep arrangements:
Neon Bounty / VS Protocol / Last Life / God Mode: Overclock.

All drum, bass, pad and chip-lead sounds were synthesized from oscillators and noise.
No third-party recordings, samples, vocals or melodies are included.
Compositions, arrangements and the reproducible renderer were created for this project.
Rendered as stereo 44.1 kHz, 192 kbps MP3 loops.
